doc.brief: A `GtkShortcutsShortcut` represents a single keyboard shortcut or gesture with a short text.
doc.deprecated_md: This widget will be removed in GTK 5
doc.md:
A `GtkShortcutsShortcut` represents a single keyboard shortcut or gesture
with a short text.

This widget is only meant to be used with `GtkShortcutsWindow`.

accel-size-group.brief: The size group for the accelerator portion of this shortcut.
accel-size-group.deprecated_md: This widget will be removed in GTK 5
accel-size-group.md:
The size group for the accelerator portion of this shortcut.

This is used internally by GTK, and must not be modified by applications.

accelerator.brief: The accelerator(s) represented by this object.
accelerator.deprecated_md: This widget will be removed in GTK 5
accelerator.md:
The accelerator(s) represented by this object.

This property is used if [`ShortcutsShortcut:shortcut-type`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ShortcutsShortcut#property:shortcut-type)
is set to %GTK_SHORTCUT_ACCELERATOR.

The syntax of this property is (an extension of) the syntax understood
by `accelerator_parse`. Multiple accelerators can be specified
by separating them with a space, but keep in mind that the available width
is limited.

It is also possible to specify ranges of shortcuts, using `...` between
the keys. Sequences of keys can be specified using a `+` or `&` between
the keys.

Examples:

- A single shortcut: `<ctl><alt>delete`
- Two alternative shortcuts: `<shift>a Home`
- A range of shortcuts: `<alt>1...<alt>9`
- Several keys pressed together: `Control_L&Control_R`
- A sequence of shortcuts or keys: `<ctl>c+<ctl>x`

Use "+" instead of "&" when the keys may (or have to be) pressed
sequentially (e.g use "t+t" for 'press the t key twice').

Note that `<`, `>` and `&` need to be escaped as `<`, `&gt`; and `&amp`; when used
in .ui files.

action-name.deprecated_md: This widget will be removed in GTK 5
action-name.md:
A detailed action name.

If this is set for a shortcut of type %GTK_SHORTCUT_ACCELERATOR,
then GTK will use the accelerators that are associated with the
action via [`Application.set_accels_for_action()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Application#method:set_accels_for_action), and
setting [`ShortcutsShortcut:accelerator`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ShortcutsShortcut#property:accelerator) is not necessary.

direction.brief: The text direction for which this shortcut is active.
direction.deprecated_md: This widget will be removed in GTK 5
direction.md:
The text direction for which this shortcut is active.

If the shortcut is used regardless of the text direction,
set this property to %GTK_TEXT_DIR_NONE.

icon.brief: An icon to represent the shortcut or gesture.
icon.deprecated_md: This widget will be removed in GTK 5
icon.md:
An icon to represent the shortcut or gesture.

This property is used if [`ShortcutsShortcut:shortcut-type`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ShortcutsShortcut#property:shortcut-type)
is set to %GTK_SHORTCUT_GESTURE.

For the other predefined gesture types, GTK provides an icon on its own.

icon-set.brief: `TRUE` if an icon has been set.
icon-set.deprecated_md: This widget will be removed in GTK 5
icon-set.md: `TRUE` if an icon has been set.

shortcut-type.brief: The type of shortcut that is represented.
shortcut-type.deprecated_md: This widget will be removed in GTK 5
shortcut-type.md: The type of shortcut that is represented.

subtitle.brief: The subtitle for the shortcut or gesture.
subtitle.deprecated_md: This widget will be removed in GTK 5
subtitle.md:
The subtitle for the shortcut or gesture.

This is typically used for gestures and should be a short, one-line
text that describes the gesture itself. For the predefined gesture
types, GTK provides a subtitle on its own.

subtitle-set.brief: `TRUE` if a subtitle has been set.
subtitle-set.deprecated_md: This widget will be removed in GTK 5
subtitle-set.md: `TRUE` if a subtitle has been set.

title.brief: The textual description for the shortcut or gesture represented by this object.
title.deprecated_md: This widget will be removed in GTK 5
title.md:
The textual description for the shortcut or gesture represented by
this object.

This should be a short string that can fit in a single line.

title-size-group.brief: The size group for the textual portion of this shortcut.
title-size-group.deprecated_md: This widget will be removed in GTK 5
title-size-group.md:
The size group for the textual portion of this shortcut.

This is used internally by GTK, and must not be modified by applications.
